patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive content sections that occupy the entire viewport, transitioning abruptly on scroll to reveal the next project or content block.
A high-contrast typographic pairing featuring an ornate, decorative serif for prominent display text and a clean, modern sans-serif for navigation and body copy.
Dominant use of stark black and deep, saturated blues or purples as background colors, providing a dramatic canvas for white typography and vibrant, multi-colored particle accents.

Sections transition by replacing the previous full-viewport content entirely on scroll. Within sections, complex 3D objects animate subtly, and dynamic particle effects shift and flow, creating a sense of depth and interactivity.
Project showcases are presented as distinct, full-screen visual experiences, each acting as a 'slide' in a scroll-driven presentation.

technique_notes: Full-screen content sections are designed to snap into view, replacing the previous section entirely as the user scrolls, creating a 'slideshow' effect. Within these sections, highly detailed 3D models are rendered and animated using WebGL/Three.js, providing subtle rotation and dynamic visual interest. Complementary dynamic particle effects are generated and animated using canvas, adding a layer of interactive texture and movement to the backgrounds.
The site employs a minimalist, sticky header navigation that remains visible across all full-screen content sections, providing persistent access to core site links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, decorative serif headings (~5-8x body) create dramatic visual impact, contrasted with small, clean sans-serif for navigation and functional text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous negative space around full-bleed content sections, with elements often centered to enhance visual impact.

standout: This site distinguishes itself through its bold, artistic presentation of work, utilizing full-bleed, immersive project showcases that transition like a curated digital art gallery. The sophisticated integration of animated 3D sculptural elements and dynamic canvas-based particle effects as core visual features, rather than mere embellishments, creates a truly distinctive and high-impact user experience.
